settings.name: League Name
settings.bonusesDesc: Bonus riders, ITT, TTT, first win
settings.bonusFirstWinDesc: +25% of the scale points when one of your riders wins for the first time this season (individual time trial included).
settings.bonusITTDesc: Individual time trial victories also count towards the first win bonus.
settings.bonusTTTDesc: Bonus points awarded to the manager whose real team wins a team time trial.
settings.bonusScorersDesc: Bonus based on the number of distinct riders in your roster who scored at least 1 point (excluding TTT) in the phase.
settings.auctionDate: First auction round date and time
settings.auctionDateDesc: Managers will see a countdown before the auction starts
settings.startingPhaseAuto: The starting phase will be determined automatically after the first auction ends.
settings.fivePhasesExplainTitle: How does the 5 Phases mode work?
settings.fivePhasesExplainDesc: The cycling season is split into 5 phases. Each phase includes an auction session to strengthen your roster. Points are counted from the effective start date of your league.
settings.fivePhasesMidSeasonHint: You can create a league mid-season: only results after the last auction round will count, even if a stage race is in progress.

five_phases.name: 5 Phases Mode
five_phases.description: Full season or World Tour, with auctions per phase. Budget 2200, 30 riders roster.

perCourse.name: Per Race Mode
perCourse.description: Choose your races. Budget and roster size calculated automatically based on your selection.
